A '''pin-up poster''' was put up in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It showed a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Lethal" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> posing with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] against a beautiful landscape<ref name="Lethal" /> similar to the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]], a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> while dressed in an outfit<ref name="Lethal" /> similar to the battle attires worn by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier.<ref name="TPM" /> [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters were printed on the [[Painting/Legends|poster]], which appeared to read "ATN" on one side of the woman's head, and "ABOO" on the other side, seemingly "AT NABOO".<ref name="Lethal" />
